purpose: Give learned/opaque retrieval accelerators a revocable, empirically scoped right to execute while preserving deterministic fallback.

RouteValidityCertificate.admission: route only if certificate hash/version matches current field+index and risk_upper_bound <= target_risk and query is inside declared validity scope
RouteValidityCertificate.non_authority: certificate permits an accelerator query, never truth/effect/reentry authority

ShadowRiskSentinel.mechanism: sample a configurable fraction of accelerated routes; run exact/reference path in shadow; compare selected canonical references; update online risk evidence
ShadowRiskSentinel.tripwire: evidence of risk violation, hash drift, epoch mismatch, unexplained distribution drift, or repeated disagreement -> QUARANTINE accelerator + fallback
ShadowRiskSentinel.recovery: recalibrate/rebuild in shadow; new certificate required before READY

hard_negative: finite-sample IID calibration alone did not protect against a constructed same-index tail shift; universal guarantee is forbidden
interaction_with_canonical_rebind: canonical rebind proves returned candidate identity/state validity, not retrieval optimality/relevance; routing risk and authority proof are separate.
